svg.title: Current DV dashboard pipeline
svg.desc: Native schema version 1 results are collected into schema version 0.1 records, rendered into reports and a dashboard, optionally added to schema version 0.2 history, then published to timestamped and latest locations.
svg.text: Each command reads and writes files; no database or direct runner invocation is required.
Dashed arrow: optional history input/output loop
